evidence.reason: The current dependency regex enumerates many [Unit] dependency directives but omits `PropagatesStopTo` and its inverse `StopPropagatedFrom`. A co-installed unit with `PropagatesStopTo=crq-tick.service` creates exactly the kind of cross-unit stop relationship this scan is meant to detect; missing it can leave discovery reporting the selected unit as supported when stopping the other unit would stop it. This is an ordinary completeness defect in the existing dependency detection, not a new requirement.
